content.user_title: Map large codebases with focused symbol search
content.value_statement: Large repositories can overwhelm code exploration and consume limited context. This skill builds a local symbol index so you can retrieve targeted code and preserve project knowledge.
actual_capabilities: Indexes Python, Rust, and C++ symbols into a local repository map.
Searches indexed functions, classes, methods, and types through MCP tools.
Retrieves indexed symbol content and file-level symbol lists.
Detects similar code patterns with fuzzy matching.
Tracks indexing status and supports manual reindexing.
Stores project narratives, learnings, and cross-session goals in Claude directories.
limitations: Language indexing is limited to Python, Rust, and C++.
MCP symbol tools require the plugin server to load and the repository to be indexed.
Initial indexing can take time on large repositories.
Narrative generation requires an Anthropic API key and supported Claude tooling.

use_cases.title: Navigate an unfamiliar service
use_cases.description: Find the relevant classes and functions before changing a large existing codebase.

use_cases.title: Prepare an implementation plan
use_cases.description: Locate related symbols and dependencies to create a focused technical plan.

use_cases.title: Preserve team knowledge
use_cases.description: Maintain project narratives, learnings, and goals across Claude Code sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Find a symbol
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the symbol named AuthService and show its signature, location, and related methods.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a module
prompt_templates.prompt: List the indexed symbols in src/api.py. Summarize each public function in one sentence.

prompt_templates.title: Trace an implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for symbols related to payment retries. Identify the main flow and the files I should review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a safe change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the repository map to find all symbols affected by adding a cache to the config loader. Propose a change plan and test scope.

output: The result includes its signature, source location, and available methods.
A file-level list of functions and classes with signatures.
A concise summary of the module’s public responsibilities.
The response reports symbol count and the most recent index time.

best_practices: Use symbol search before broad text search when you know a code identifier.
Wait for initial indexing to complete before relying on symbol results.
Review generated narratives and learnings before treating them as team documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not use the index as the only source of truth for unindexed languages or generated files.
Do not store secrets in project narratives, learnings, or goals.
Do not assume a symbol search result proves runtime behavior without reviewing the source.

faq.question: Which languages can this skill index?
faq.answer: It indexes Python, Rust, and C++ source files.

faq.question: Does it require an MCP server?
faq.answer: MCP tools provide the primary symbol-query interface after the plugin server loads.

faq.question: Where is the repository index stored?
faq.answer: The skill documents a local index at .claude/repo-map.db in the project.

faq.question: Can I use it before indexing finishes?
faq.answer: Some tools wait for indexing, but complete results require a finished index.

faq.question: Does it send my code to a remote service?
faq.answer: The documented repository map is local. Review the plugin and your Claude configuration for any optional remote features.

faq.question: What is needed for narrative generation?
faq.answer: The documentation lists Python, uv, and an Anthropic API key for narrative generation.
